title: Choose the location first
text: Location and locality carry the most signal for popularity; compare candidate localities before deciding cuisine or price. Caveat: outside Delhi NCR the data lists mostly well-known restaurants, so part of the location effect reflects how Zomato sampled cities.

title: Offer table booking where the format allows it
text: It goes with a much higher share of High-popularity restaurants (association, not proof of cause).

title: Use delivery for reach, not for rating
text: In India, delivery goes with a higher High-popularity share (44.6% vs 27.2%) but ratings barely differ (3.37 vs 3.34); service quality still drives the rating.

title: Mind the price band
text: Mid and upper price ranges are more often High-popularity; budget outlets compete in a crowded, lower-voted segment.

title: Help unrated restaurants get their first ratings
text: A fifth of listings have no rating; platform prompts or owner follow-up would make them comparable.

title: Use the model as a screen, not a verdict
text: It separates likely High from likely Low well; Medium predictions near a cut-off are uncertain.
